name: Async refactor
pitch: Refactor a function to use async/await and handle errors properly
instructions: Find the function in the workspace. Read the whole file that contains it. Identify the function name and its parameters. Rewrite the function body to use async/await syntax. Add a try/catch block around the async operations. Catch any errors and return a clear error message. Write the modified file back to the workspace. If the file cannot be read or written, say so and stop.

examples.does: reads the file, rewrites the function with async/await and try/catch, saves the file
finds the function, wraps it in try/catch, returns error details if it fails

readme: Async Refactor: reads a file, rewrites a function to use async/await with proper error handling, and saves the changes. Will not run commands or modify anything outside the workspace.
